answer_1.quote: Grammatical error correction (GEC) is the task of detecting and correcting grammatical errors present in a text ... We present our simple yet effective system combination method for grammatical error correction that outperforms all prior state-of-theart systems on both CoNLL-2014 and BEA-2019 shared tasks.
answer_1.outputs: Corrected grammatical sentences generated by combining edits from base systems.

answer_2.quote: We use the Max-Match (M2) scorer to obtain the CoNLL-2014 results and ERRANT scorer to obtain the BEA-2019 results.
